name: Standing Guard
text: You have always known which side of an ally to stand on. The first Impact Roll made each round against an ally within 5ft of you is Downgraded.

name: The Unanswered Threat
text: Being overlooked is an insult you are glad to collect on. The first time each round that an enemy within your melee reach attacks anyone but you, you gain 1 Momentum.

name: Iron Skin
text: Your armor stops the blow, and your body argues with whatever is left of it. When you take Slashing, Piercing, or Bludgeoning damage, spend 1 Vigor Point to roll your Vigor Die and reduce that damage by the result. This costs you no Reaction and happens once per round.

name: Iron Hold
text: You take hold of them, and the fight becomes a conversation about who lets go first. For 1 AP and 1 Vigor Point, roll your Vigor Die against the Vigor Defense of an enemy within your melee reach; on a hit it is Grappled, and your own Speed is 0 for as long as you hold it. On a Glancing Blow it is Slowed by 10ft until the end of its next turn instead.

name: Interpose
text: The space between an ally and the thing coming for them is yours to occupy. As a Reaction when an attack is declared against an ally within 5ft of you, spend 1 Momentum to step into its path and become its target instead. The attacker resolves the attack against your Defense Ratings.

name: Every Blow That Fails
text: A blow that breaks on your guard leaves you steadier than it found you. When an attack against you results in a Glancing Blow, spend 1 Momentum to roll your Vigor Die and regain that many Hit Points. This happens once per round.

name: Punish the Attempt
text: Turning away from you should cost more than it saves. When you make an Opportunity Attack, spend 2 Momentum to add one Vigor Die to its Impact Roll; if that attack deals damage, the target must succeed on a Vigor Save or be knocked Prone.

name: Fortress of One
text: Requires any two Bulwark Majors. You plant your feet, and the fight bends its path around you. For 1 AP, 2 Momentum, and 1 Vigor Point your Speed becomes 0 until you end the stance at the start of one of your turns; while it holds, every Impact Roll made against you or against an ally within 5ft is Downgraded, and neither of you can be moved against your will or knocked Prone. An enemy that starts its turn within 15ft of you must succeed on a Vigor Save or spend 10ft of its movement closing on you.

name: Absolute Defense
text: Nothing falls behind you while you are still on your feet. Once per combat, when you or an ally within 10ft of you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, spend 2 Vigor Points: an ally's damage is dealt to you instead as True Damage, and either way that damage cannot reduce you below 1 Hit Point. Until the end of your next turn every Impact Roll made against you is Downgraded, and you cannot be moved against your will.
